note: RIDDLER SEAT 8 — the magician. Riddle: form is a spell and the medium does things to the reader. Stego-native: Promethea contains operative occult diagrams; the text IS the grimoire. Equivalents ride this shelf (Angela Carter, Burroughs, Grant Morrison).
interactions: mentor Steve Moore (the Moon and Serpent circle); the performance-magic cycle (The Birth Caul, Snakes and Ladders, The Highbury Working, Angel Passage) is their joint doctrine staged
friendship then estrangement with Neil Gaiman: 1980s Northampton collaborators, cooled in the Watchmen-rights era
long feud with Grant Morrison — mutually vitriolic over magic and craft; Morrison hid real sigils in The Invisibles, so both magicians embed stego (edge within shelf)
Burroughs' cut-up is Jerusalem's psychogeographic ancestor
Watchmen (1986-87) is the medium's proof that form can carry meaning the plot never states — the panel structure itself rhymes (fearful symmetry)
walled: comics: Saga of the Swamp Thing run (1983-87); Watchmen (1986-87, w/ Dave Gibbons); V for Vendetta (1982-88, w/ David Lloyd); Miracleman (1982-89); From Hell (1989-96, w/ Eddie Campbell); Promethea (1999-2005, w/ J.H. Williams III); The League of Extraordinary Gentlemen (1999-2019, w/ Kevin O'Neill, incl. the Nemo trilogy and The Tempest); Supreme: Story of the Year; Top 10 (w/ Gene Ha); Tom Strong; the ABC line; Lost Girls (w/ Melinda Gebbie); A Small Killing; The Ballad of Halo Jones (w/ Ian Gibson); Skizz; D.R. & Quinch; The Bojeffries Saga; Big Numbers (unfinished)
